payload.title: Reading section: short posts about papers and books
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-09-26: a simple article section for mentions of papers and books, hand-written, not automated. A reading tag, a /reading listing page in the shape of /research, a Reading entry in the menu, and a short how-to in AGENTS.md. Seed it by tagging the nine published posts that are each about one paper.
